dedupeText: psychedelic folk pop album cover psychedelic folk pop 1960s collage surrealism slab serif watercolor illustration portrait integrated into the collage rather than sitting on top of it typography stacked at the top with decreasing scale for secondary lines muted watercolor palette contrasting with bold typographic colors surrealist vignettes overlapping the subject s torso combine a central line art portrait with surreal watercolor collage elements and a top heavy stack of vintage slab serif typography on a cream background

retrievalProfile.description: A central line-art portrait integrated into a surreal collage of watercolor vignettes and stacked slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: surreal collage portrait with watercolor vignettes

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male portrait rendered in fine line-art, surrounded by a dreamlike collage of watercolor illustrations including globes, trees, and figures, topped by a multi-layered typographic header in varying colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait integrated into the collage rather than sitting on top of it
Typography stacked at the top with decreasing scale for secondary lines
Muted watercolor palette contrasting with bold typographic colors
Surrealist vignettes overlapping the subject's torso
coreInvariants: Central line-art portrait with realistic facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central male portrait, medium shot, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large green slab-serif title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top typography, moves down to the face, then circles through the surrounding collage vignettes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cream-colored background provides breathing room around the dense central and top elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark purple and forest green for primary typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted watercolors (pink, yellow, blue, green) in the collage
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in typography; low to medium saturation in the illustrative elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors
Stick to a 1960s earthy and pastel palette

letterConstructionRules: Heavy rectangular serifs for the main title
High stroke contrast for the artist name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking multiple weights and colors of serif and slab-serif fonts for a hierarchical list.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic of the main title
Appropriate for the secondary serif text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored background with a central line-art male portrait integrated with surreal watercolor vignettes (globe, trees, figures).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked, centered slab-serif and serif text at the top in dark purple, red, and green, separated by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the typography stacked and centered?
Are the collage elements rendered in a watercolor style?
Is the portrait integrated with the surrounding illustrations?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Verify centered alignment of all text
Confirm the portrait is line-art based
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central line-art portrait with surreal watercolor collage elements and a top-heavy stack of vintage slab-serif typography on a cream background.
